# Arpita Mehta, Presence Consultant, Delhi

> Presence consultant in Delhi working across four disciplines (image, executive presence, social culture, and AI for branding and business) for executives, founders, brides, graduates and homemakers. Over ten years in marketing before moving into presence work; WSET-qualified in wines; certified Train the Trainer and soft skills facilitator. Four licensed cohort programmes run roughly twice a year; one-to-one consulting runs year-round. Based in Delhi, works online with clients across India and internationally.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://arpitamehta.co/): the four-pillar overview (Image, Executive Presence, Social Culture, AI for Branding & Business) and how they combine into one "room-ready" result.
- [About](https://arpitamehta.co/about.html): Arpita's background, the gap she identified between credentials and presence, and why the practice is built the way it is.
- [Services](https://arpitamehta.co/services.html): the four licensed programmes (The Presence Edit, The Executive Edge, The Social Table, The Debut) and one-to-one consulting, with who each is for.
- [FAQ](https://arpitamehta.co/faq.html): detailed, specific answers on the practice, who it's for, how to begin, the programmes, results and process, and privacy.
- [Resources](https://arpitamehta.co/resources.html): the Presence Quotient assessment and downloadable guides.
- [Presence Quotient Assessment](https://arpitamehta.co/assessment.html): a free 16-question self-assessment producing a score, a band, and a private scorecard.
- [Booking](https://arpitamehta.co/booking.html): the three ways to work with Arpita one to one, with current prices, and the page where sessions are actually booked and paid for.

## One-to-one sessions and prices

All three are booked and paid for at https://arpitamehta.co/booking.html. Payment is taken first, then the client chooses a time on the calendar that follows.

- Discovery Call: ₹339, 15 minutes, online, available anywhere in the world. A conversation to work out whether the practice is the right fit.
- Video Consultation: ₹2,049, 45 minutes, online, available anywhere in the world. Where the discovery call decides whether to work together, this one does the work: image, how you read on camera and in a room, and the single gap costing you the most.
- In Person Consultation: ₹4,299, 1 hour, face to face in Delhi. You leave with three things to change that month, and a written summary follows within two days.

Group programmes and corporate training are quoted separately; see the Services page.

Free to reschedule with at least 24 hours' notice. No refund inside 24 hours or for a no-show. Full refund or a free reschedule if Arpita cancels. Full policy: https://arpitamehta.co/faq.html#cancellation-policy
